title: Sport announces the arrival of Patrick de Paula
seoTitle: Sport announces signing of midfielder Patrick de Paula
subtitle: The defensive midfielder arrives to bolster the midfield in Série B
excerpt: Sport has officially confirmed the signing of defensive midfielder Patrick de Paula, a former Libertadores champion with Palmeiras and Botafogo.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Last Monday, Sport announced the signing of defensive midfielder Patrick de Paula, formerly of Palmeiras and Botafogo, who will now be a central piece in the Pernambuco-based midfield. The 26-year-old athlete already has experience in international and national titles, and his arrival responds to a priority demand for reinforcement in the position.

Patrick de Paula arrives in Recife with a contract until 2026

The player underwent medical examinations at the club's training facility and signed a contract valid until November 30, 2026. The agreement provides for contractual triggers that could lead to an automatic extension, depending on the athlete's performance on the pitch and Sport's success in their Série A promotion campaign.

International experience and achievements in Brazil

Developed in Palmeiras' youth ranks, Patrick de Paula has already surpassed the 100-match mark for the São Paulo club. He was part of three Libertadores titles – two with Palmeiras (2020, 2021) and one with Botafogo (2024). In addition, he participated in triumphs such as the Copa do Brasil, the Recopa Sudamericana, and the Campeonato Paulista with Palmeiras, and the Campeonato Brasileiro with Botafogo.

Stints at other clubs before arriving at Sport

  • Botafogo – 58 matches, 2 goals, and 4 assists
  • Criciúma – loan
  • Estoril Praia (Portugal) – 9 matches, 1 goal

Internal competition in Sport's midfield

Within the squad, Patrick de Paula will face direct competition from players such as Zé Gabriel, Willian Oliveira, Murilo, Biel, and Pedro Martins, who are already vying for the starting spot in Série B.

The club's objective for the season

Sport aims to regain promotion to Série A this season. The signing of Patrick de Paula is part of a strategy to reinforce the defensive midfield position, with the goal of strengthening the midfield and increasing the chances of success in the competition.

With information from GE, LANCE!.
